headline: BEML Limited files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares to NSE
sum: BEML Limited has filed a mandatory SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure under Regulation 31(4), signalling a substantial acquisition event. The filing details are contained in the NSE archive, with specific acquirer identity, stake acquired, and transaction value not disclosed in the Bar & Bench article excerpt.
detail: BEML Limited, a Ministry of Defence PSU under the Department of Defence Production, submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 17 June 2026. This regulation mandates disclosure when a person acquires 5% or more of shares in a listed company, or when there is a change of control or intent to acquire control. The complete disclosure document is housed in the NSE corporate archives and contains the identity of the acquirer, number/percentage of shares acquired, and transaction consideration.
